elasticity.definition: beta_B = dF/dln(B) in percentage points of F per unit ln(baseline rate); beta_p = dF/dln(p); gamma = dln(B)/dln(p). Two-point slopes are finite differences between seed-paired conditions; OLS slopes are equal-weight.

slope_labels.env_low_mid: environment full model, p .0810 to .1080 (separate 512-seed bank)
slope_labels.env_mid_high: environment full model, p .1080 to .1350 (separate 512-seed bank)
slope_labels.env_ols3: environment full model, three-point OLS (B 0.40 to 2.29; below the target region)
slope_labels.piecewise: piecewise-local: low->center slope below the center, center->high slope above it (independent: center->high on both sides, no paired lower point)

bias.definition: bias = F(B_obs) - F(3.0) ~= beta_B * ln(B_obs/3), in percentage points. F at 3.0 ~= F_obs - bias. Negative shortfall (B_obs < 3) with negative beta_B gives a positive bias (observed F too high), and vice versa.
bias.interval_notes: beta_only: shortfall fixed at its point value, slope resampled. joint: shortfall and slope both resampled (aligned draws where seeds are shared).

bias.contrast_definition: contrast bias = bias(a) - bias(b); adjusted contrast = observed contrast - contrast bias. Post hoc and descriptive; it relies on the same local log-linearity and (alternative workflow) slope-transfer assumptions.

selection.definition: implied F shift = dF/dln p x ln(p_bound/p_selected), in percentage points. Quadrature half-widths combine the archived conditional MC half-width and the selection half-width as if independent and symmetric (descriptive only).

routes.definition: Passive labels of the pickup that began the infecting hand contamination episode. own_current = own-zone site pickup, contamination from the current stay; carry_over = own_zone_environment_pickup_after_readmission (site lineage predates the current admission); suffix _0/_pos = zero / at least one intervening hygiene opportunity. reduction = 1 - policy/control; contribution_to_F = (control rate - policy rate of label) / total control rate, which sums to F over the four labels.
